title: Formal-verification team config
description: Schema for formal-verification.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): version pins and default bounds. Every key is optional; an absent key takes its value from the plugin's defaults.json. scripts/settings.mjs resolves the layers. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

model_checker.description: The TLC model checker jar that /formal-verification:setup apply install-model-checker downloads and checks.

version.description: Release of tla2tools.jar, used in the installed file name.

url.description: Where the jar is downloaded from.

sha256.description: The jar's SHA-256, lowercase hex. A download that does not match is discarded.

java.description: The Java that runs TLC. The plugin never installs Java.

min_version.description: Lowest Java major version setup accepts.

distribution.description: The Java distribution setup names in its install hint.

renderer.description: The image renderer, used only when an image of a chart is asked for.

package.description: npm package name of the renderer.

integrity.description: The tarball's sha512 Subresource Integrity string. A download that does not match is discarded.

bounds.description: Default bounds for /formal-verification:chart. A model's run command can pass its own.

chart_states.description: The chart budget in distinct states (the script's --chart-states).

rerun_states.description: After the first break, each TLC run stops at this many distinct states (the script's --rerun-states).
